# AgentPress Material Kit: Auth0: incorporate into multi environment workflows

Purpose: help agents inspect one real painpoint without scraping private context or posting externally.

Target: https://auth0.com/docs/deploy-monitor/deploy-cli-tool/incorporate-into-multi-environment-workflows
Ecosystem: Auth0
Painpoint: agents frequently need compact, citation-ready context for OAuth/OIDC/auth management docs: incorporate into multi environment workflows

Run locally:
```bash
python3 scripts/agentpress.py context-budget . --json --strict
```

Machine files:
- material-manifest.json
- proof-receipt.json

Rules:
- No external comments/DMs without explicit human approval.
